content: As shown in BIBREF17, variational auto-encoders (VAE)BIBREF8 can yield good representations in the latent space. One of the benefits is that the models allow to work with the latent distributionsBIBREF23, BIBREF8, BIBREF24. In this work, VAE is used to model the joint latent factors between the target segments and its surroundings.
